stories.title: Random access quantum memory lets one processor select among seven storage cells
stories.desc: Classical computers can temporarily store the information required to perform specific tasks in a short-term memory component known as RAM (random access memory). This component allows computer processors to retrieve information from a chosen location without searching through all stored data.
